function: Learned UAV 3D deployment and transmit power control for a multi-UAV ISCPT downlink, maximizing weighted min-SINR, min sensing RSP and min harvested energy (pp. 8-9).
system: Four single-antenna UAVs; single-antenna ground users (30 information, 30 energy, 12 sensing targets); probabilistic LoS channel; no RIS; carrier frequency not stated (pp. 4, 12).
method: Pareto-conditioned residual graph attention network (PCGNN) with FiLM weight conditioning, unsupervised training on the scalarized objective; weight space split into subregions, one model each (pp. 7-11).
data_channel: Own simulator: probabilistic LoS/NLoS air-to-ground model with random small-scale fading (Eqs. 1-5); users from a binomial point process; no standard or measured channel (pp. 5, 12).
test_conditions: Weights sampled per subregion in training; tested on a uniform weight grid (step 0.02) in the same four-UAV scenario; no other UAV or user counts (pp. 11-15).
baselines: FW-based DL (one model per weight, 1326 models), PCGNN-only (N = 1), MOPPO (multi-objective reinforcement learning), all with the same RGAT network; no non-learned baseline (p. 14).
metrics: Hypervolume, number of non-dominated solutions, sparsity, weight-space coverage, trained and stored model counts; min SINR, min RSP and min harvested energy in Table IV (pp. 13-16).
complexity: Big-O of PCGNN (Eq. 38, p. 11); trained models 55 vs 1326 for FW-based DL (96% reduction) and stored models 29 vs 312 (Table III, p. 15).
q1_support: p. 5: "a probabilistic LoS channel model is employed to characterize the wireless links between UAVs and ground users"; custom model with the LoS probability of ref. [42], and no 3GPP, other standard model or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 12: "four UAVs are deployed to cooperatively provide ISCPT services"; one scenario is simulated and only the weight vector and its sampling step vary (p. 15), which is an input of the model and not a new scenario.
q3_support: p. 14: "we compare it with three representative baselines, i.e., PCGNN-only, FW-based DL, and multi-objective proximal policy optimization (MOPPO)-based"; all are learned (variants of the method or MORL), and no non-learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 11: "the total complexity of PCGNN with two stages is"; Table III (p. 15) also reports trained and stored model counts.
q5_support: p. 12: "30 information users and 30 energy-harvesting users are deployed according to a binomial point process"; data are simulated by the authors, and no code or data link, DOI or public dataset is given.
notes: Area 6: learned UAV transmit power control (aerial link) jointly with 3D placement, which passes above_phy; the tie-break puts 6 before 5 and NTN admits single-antenna links (p. 4). If judged area 5 (ISAC), the single-antenna rule would exclude it. q2: the 'without retraining' claim concerns task weights, not a new scenario. q1: LoS-probability model of ref. [42], not a standardized model.
